hero_prompt: English. A quiet Korean amusement park at blue hour in early winter, an empty carousel glowing with warm lights in the middle distance, bare trees and a clear cold sky behind it, wide low-angle composition, teal and amber tones. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no real people's faces.
